spec.title: Network-based promiscuous sniffing versus host-based operating system IDS

left.title: Network Intrusion Detection (NIDS)
items: Operates promiscuously on network taps and switch SPAN ports
Analyzes raw Ethernet frames across entire network subnets
Inspects unencrypted packet headers without host overhead

right.title: Host Intrusion Detection (HIDS)
items: Resides directly on individual endpoints and servers
Monitors local system calls authentication logs and rootkits
Inspects decrypted payload contents directly at the endpoint

steps.caption: Network sensors analyze raw packets across subnets without host burdens.
Host monitors inspect local system calls and authentication logs.

entries.partTitle: Signature-Based Matching vs Protocol Anomaly Detection

spec.title: Signature-based pattern matching versus protocol anomaly detection

left.title: Signature-Based Pattern Matching
items: Searches packet payloads for documented exploit byte patterns
Extremely efficient with near zero false positive rates
Blind to unknown zero-day attacks and polymorphic payloads

right.title: Protocol Anomaly Detection
items: Models normal protocol standards and RFC specifications
Flags unexpected deviations illegal headers and port abuse
Catches novel zero-day attacks and evasive techniques

steps.caption: Signatures search packet payloads for specific byte sequences.
Anomaly detection models normal specifications and flags deviations.
